items.title: Senior SEO Specialist
items.description:
Siamo alla ricerca di una persona per la posizione di S enior SEO Specialis t, che gestisca la relazione in modo strategico, sviluppando sia la strategia che l'operatività per progetti complessi e con un forte orientamento al risultato.

Farai parte dell'area SEO e sarai responsabile di un portafoglio di clienti strategici.

Ruolo

Come Senior SEO Specialist ti occuperai di:

Autonomia nell'ottimizzazione strategica dei siti web: gestirai le attività SEO per importanti progetti italiani e internazionali, lavorando su analisi tecniche e analisi dati, strategie on-site e off-site per massimizzare visibilità e traffico organico
Gestione della relazione: diventerai il punto di riferimento operativo per i tuoi clienti, costruendo una relazione basata sulla fiducia e sulla capacità di rispondere ai loro bisogni di business
Individuazione proattiva di opportunità: analizzerai costantemente i dati per identificare problemi tecnici o nuovi spazi di crescita, elaborando soluzioni concrete per migliorare le performance dei progetti
Realizzazione pratica degli interventi: sarai responsabile dell'implementazione pratica delle soluzioni progettate, collaborando se necessario con i team di sviluppo
Evoluzione della ricerca con l'AI: integrerai l'uso di strumenti di AI generativa (come ChatGPT, Gemini o Google AI Studio) per rendere più efficienti i tuoi flussi di lavoro e anticipare i cambiamenti nelle abitudini di ricerca degli utenti
Monitoraggio dei nuovi paradigmi di ricerca: seguirai attivamente l'evoluzione della Search (es. AI Overviews, AI Mode) per adattare le strategie SEO a un panorama che va oltre la ricerca tradizionale
Storytelling del dato: tradurrai analisi complesse in report chiari e insight azionabili, comunicando efficacemente il valore del lavoro svolto agli stakeholder sui progetti

Requirements

Cosa ci aspettiamo da te

Cerchiamo una persona con una solida base tecnica, visione strategica e una forte curiosità.

Must Have

Hai 4+ anni di esperienza in ambito SEO (agenzia o azienda)
Ampia autonomia strategica e operativa nella gestione dei progetti
Padroneggi la SEO tecnica, on-page, off-site e la content strategy
Usi con disinvoltura i principali tool del settore (Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, etc.)
Sai analizzare dati (Google Analytics, Google Search Console) e trasformarli in insight per i clienti
Hai esperienza pratica con strumenti di AI generativa (ChatGPT Plus, Gemini Pro, Google AI Studio) per efficientare i flussi di lavoro e progettare soluzioni SEO innovative
Parli e scrivi in inglese in modo fluente

Nice to Have

Hai gestito progetti SEO internazionali
Conoscenza di una terza lingua

Il nostro processo di selezione

Puntiamo a essere veloci e trasparenti.

Colloquio conoscitivo: un colloquio via Google Meet di un'ora con il nostro team HR per conoscerci
Colloquio tecnico: un'ora con Team Manager e SEO Director per approfondire di persona e discutere di una breve esercitazione pratica che ti chiederemo di preparare
Offerta: se tutto va bene, ti daremo il benvenuto nel team!

Benefits

Avrai la possibilità di entrare a far parte di un team affiatato a cui offriamo:

Lavoro flessibile: smart working e flessibilità oraria
Crescita continua: piano di sviluppo concordato con il proprio responsabile, tempo dedicato per formazione, corsi, libri e partecipazione a eventi di settore. Accesso illimitato ad Upskill for Webrankers, la nostra piattaforma interna di corsi e-learning
Benessere al primo posto. Piano welfare, buoni pasto elettronici (anche quando sei in smart working, spendibili ovunque) e contributo Smart Working Station per lavorare meglio da casa
Innovazione. Tempo e risorse dedicate a progetti R&D per sperimentare e rimanere sempre un passo avanti
Welcome kit: zaino, borraccia, laptop e postazione di lavoro dedicata
Possibilità di partecipare ad eventi di team building aziendali (cene a tema, grigliate estive, ecc) offerti da Webranking
Spazi di relax e svago, dove rilassarsi e divertirsi con i colleghi (a Correggio avrai a tua disposizione una palestra e, nei mesi estivi, la piscina)

Cosa Offriamo

Contratto di assunzione CCNL Commercio, range retributivo 32.000-40.000 euro lordi annui. In base agli elementi che emergeranno durante la selezione verrà definita l'offerta economica finale.

items.title: SEO Specialist
items.description:
SEO Specialist – Marketing
Company: Urban Vault Department: Marketing / Growth Experience: 3+ years

About the Role
Urban Vault is an interior design company. We are looking for an SEO Specialist who can help more people find us on Google and turn those visitors into enquiries. You will plan and run our SEO work from start to finish, covering website, content, and tracking results.
What You Will Do
Plan and run our overall SEO strategy to increase organic traffic and enquiries
Do keyword research for interior design services, locations, and project types
Improve on-page SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and URLs
Fix technical SEO issues such as site speed, indexing, crawl errors, sitemaps, and mobile-friendliness
Work with the content team to plan blogs, service pages, and project pages that rank well
Build and manage quality backlinks through outreach, listings, and partnerships
Manage and improve our Google Business Profile and local SEO
Track rankings, traffic, and leads using Google Analytics, Search Console, and other tools
Study competitors and find new chances to grow
Share simple monthly reports with the team on what worked and what to do next
Work with the design, development, and marketing teams to put SEO changes live
What We Are Looking For
3+ years of hands-on experience in SEO (on-page, off-page, and technical)
Good knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Screaming Frog
Understanding of how Google updates and ranking factors work
Experience in local SEO and Google Business Profile
Basic knowledge of HTML and CMS platforms like WordPress
Good writing skills and the ability to review content for SEO
Ability to read data and turn it into clear action points
Experience in interior design, real estate, or a service business is a plus
Good to Have
Experience with Google Ads or other paid marketing
Knowledge of schema markup and structured data
Experience in improving lead quality, not just traffic

Company: Weingenious Technocrats LLP

About Us
Weingenious Technocrats LLP is a fast-growing digital studio specializing in website development, custom software solutions, and SaaS products. We help businesses build strong digital solutions and grow online.
About the Role
We are hiring an SEO Specialist with 6 months to 2 years of hands-on SEO experience. You will be responsible for improving website rankings, increasing organic traffic, and implementing effective SEO strategies.
Key Responsibilities
• Perform keyword research and competitor analysis
• Handle on-page SEO (meta tags, content optimization, internal linking, URL optimization)
• Execute off-page SEO (link building, backlinks, submissions)
• Monitor keyword rankings and website performance
• Use SEO tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/SEMrush, etc.
• Identify basic technical SEO issues and coordinate with the team
• Prepare SEO reports and track improvements
Required Skills
• 6 months -2 years of experience in SEO
• Hands-on knowledge of on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and keyword research
• Experience with SEO tools and Google Search Console
• Basic understanding of technical SEO
• Good analytical and communication skills
Who Should Apply
✅ Candidates with practical SEO experience
✅ Candidates who have worked on website optimization and ranking improvement
Who Should Not Apply
❌ Candidates with only social media or paid marketing experience

Fixed salary plus growth opportunities, based on skills and experience.

You’ll manage a book of client accounts from onboarding through monthly reporting, and you’ll work closely with those clients along the way. Being comfortable on calls and explaining SEO in a way business owners can follow is a big part of the job.

Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Execution
Develop and manage SEO strategies for multiple clients
Perform keyword research, site audits, GEO audits and keyword mapping
Write and optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, service pages, location pages and FAQs
Conduct competitor research to find gaps and opportunities
Local SEO
Manage Google Business Profiles, including posts, review responses, photos and listing cleanup
Build and maintain citations and backlinks
Keep business information accurate and consistent across listings
Technical SEO
Identify and resolve technical issues such as crawlability, indexing, site speed and mobile usability
Implement schema markup, internal linking and redirects in WordPress, Wix and Shopify
Work with client developers on fixes that need their access
Make sure tracking, goals and events are set up correctly in analytics platforms
Performance & Reporting
Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, CTR and conversions
Use SE Ranking, Google Analytics, Google Search Console and similar tools
Create clear monthly reports and the client emails that explain them
Lead client calls to review results and next steps
Make data-driven recommendations to improve ROI and hit growth goals
Content & Collaboration
Write and optimize blogs, landing pages and site copy that sound like the client
Align SEO strategy with our paid media and social teams on shared clients
Keep tasks and deadlines current in Monday.com
Non-Negotiables
2+ years of proven experience managing SEO accounts and driving organic growth, ideally for local service businesses
A portfolio or case studies showing SEO results, such as before and after rankings, traffic growth or a Google Business Profile turned into a lead source
Hands-on experience with major SEO tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SE Ranking, Semrush or Ahrefs
Experience working in WordPress, Wix and Shopify sites
Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data and KPIs
Excellent communication and client-facing skills
Solid project management and the ability to juggle 10+ clients at once
Skills and Competencies
Ability to analyze and interpret performance metrics
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
Proficiency in Google Analytics and tracking setup
Ability to use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to support content, creativity and data analysis
Clear writing for web content, client emails and reports
Creative and strategic thinking

Experience with GEO and AI search visibility (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity)
Schema markup written by hand in JSON-LD
Familiarity with Local Services Ads or Google Ads
Experience with Monday.com
Experience running SEO for clients across different industries and locations, from single-location shops to multi-location businesses

This unique collaboration creates an environment where your skills can truly shine, enabling you to make a meaningful impact on the platform’s growth, visibility, and overall success.

We are looking for an insight-driven SEO specialist who is working at the forefront of the AI Search (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) era, with proven experience in scaling organic growth and visibility. You will bring strong fundamentals, but this is not a traditional SEO role. The landscape has evolved, and this position focuses on shaping strategy, experimentation, and insights across modern discovery systems. Our goal is to lead in AI visibility and define how legal professionals and platforms show up across these emerging surfaces, supported by a strong commitment to innovation, continuous testing, and rapid, scalable execution.

Responsibilities
Conduct thorough keyword research using tools like Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Keyword Planner to uncover content opportunities.
Optimize on-page SEO elements meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, and content structure - to improve SERP rankings.
Develop and manage a content calendar aligned with marketing goals and campaign timelines.
Collaborate with the SEO, design, and marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand voice and strategy.
Track content performance via Google Analytics and Search Console; iterate based on traffic, rankings, and engagement data.
Identify and fill content gaps through competitive research and audience analysis.
Repurpose long-form content into social posts, infographics, newsletters, and other formats.
Stay current with Google algorithm updates, AI search trends, and content marketing best practices.

2–4 years of proven experience as a content writer with a strong SEO focus.

Solid understanding of on-page SEO, keyword strategy, and content architecture.
Proficiency with SEO and analytics tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Analytics, Search Console).
Experience with CMS platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, or similar.
Excellent research, writing, editing, and proofreading skills with meticulous attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently.

Preferred Skills
Experience with AI writing tools and ability to prompt, review, and refine AI-generated content.
Familiarity with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for AI-driven search platforms.
Basic understanding of HTML/CSS for content formatting.
Experience with email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, HubSpot, etc.).

🔴 طراحی و پیاده‌سازی وب‌سایت شرکتی و کاتالوگ صنعتی آنلاین

🔹 عنوان پروژه (Project Title):
طراحی و پیاده‌سازی وب‌سایت شرکتی و کاتالوگ صنعتی آنلاین (UI اختصاصی + ریسپانسیو + سئو تکنیکال)
مهارت‌های مورد نیاز (Skills / Tags):
• WordPress (وردپرس)
• طراحی رابط کاربری (UI/UX Design)
• فیگما (Figma)
• HTML5 / CSS3 / JavaScript
• سئو تکنیکال (Technical SEO)
• بهینه‌سازی سرعت سایت (Speed Optimization)
• طراحی قالب وردپرس اختصاصی
توضیحات کامل پروژه (Project Description):
شرکت مهندسی فعال در حوزه طراحی، مهندسی معکوس و ساخت تجهیزات خطوط فرآوری معدنی و متالورژی (سیستم‌های انتقال مواد، تجهیزات فرآوری و قطعات سنگین صنعتی)، جهت راه‌اندازی وب‌سایت رسمی و کاتالوگ آنلاین خود به یک طراح/تیم توسعه‌دهنده مسلط و متعهد نیاز دارد.
کلیه ساختار معماری صفحات، متون، لیست تجهیزات و راهنمای هویت بصری برند (پالت رنگی سرمه‌ای صنعتی/فولادی و فونت سازمانی) آماده بوده و در قالب سند RFP تحویل مجری خواهد شد.
الزامات کلیدی پروژه:
1. طراحی اختصاصی UI/UX:
• طراحی پیش‌طرح و وایرفریم صفحات کلیدی در فیگما (Figma) و دریافت تأییدیه قبل از آغاز پیاده‌سازی.
• سبک بصری صنعتی، مدرن، سنگین و بدون استفاده از قالب‌های آماده بازاری یا فارسی‌سازی‌های غیراستاندارد.
• واکنش‌گرایی کامل (Full Responsive) روی موبایل، تبلت و دسکتاپ.
2. معماری و ساختار صفحات
• صفحه اصلی: هدر صنعتی، مگامنو دسته‌بندی تجهیزات، بنر Hero با شعار تخصصی، معرفی آمار و استانداردها، دسترسی ۴گانه محصولات، لوگوی مشتریان شاخص و فوتر کامل.
• کاتالوگ محصولات (۴ دسته اصلی): سیستم‌های انتقال مواد (نوار نقاله و...)، خطوط فرآوری (هیدروسیکلون، تیکنر، فیلترپرس، اسکرو فیدر و...)، مهندسی معکوس و پروژه‌های سفارشی. هر محصول شامل جدول دیتاشیت فنی، گالری، دانلود کاتالوگ PDF و دکمه استعلام.
• پروژه‌ها و نمونه‌کارها (Case Studies): با قابلیت دسته‌بندی بر اساس نوع صنعت و کارفرما.
• درباره ما و زیرساخت‌ها: معرفی دپارتمان‌های مهندسی، ماشین‌آلات کارگاهی، کنترل کیفیت و استانداردها (DIN/CEMA/ISO).
• فرم‌های تخصصی: فرم ویژه «درخواست استعلام فنی و پیش‌فاکتور (RFQ)» با قابلیت پیوست فایل نقشه‌کشی/فنی (PDF/DWG/ZIP).
3. زیرساخت فنی و پرفورمنس
• پیاده‌سازی بر پایه وردپرس سبک و امن (کدنویسی تمیز بدون افزونه‌های سنگین و زائد).
• زیرساخت چندزبانه، در حال حاضر سایت به زبان فارسی و انگلیسی مد نظر است (سیستم ماژولار جهت فعال‌سازی در فاز آتی).
• رعایت اصول سئو تکنیکال (Schemaهای سازمانی و محصول، ساختار لینک استاندارد).
• سرعت لود بالا (گرید A در GTmetrix و اسکور بالای ۸۵ در موبایل).
4. ورود محتوا، تحویل و پشتیبانی:
• بارگذاری اولیه حداقل ۱۵ محصول شاخص و ۵ پروژه نمونه بر اساس اطلاعات ارائه‌شده.
• ارائه ویدئو آموزش مدیریت پنل ادمین.
• ارائه حداقل ۳ ماه گارانتی و پشتیبانی فنی برای رفع باگ‌های احتمالی.
5. شرایط ارسال پیشنهاد (مهم)
لطفاً همکاران محترم حتماً در متن پیشنهاد موارد زیر را ذکر بفرمایند:
1. حداقل ۲ نمونه‌کار وب‌سایت صنعتی یا شرکتی B2B واقعی که خودتان پیاده کرده‌اید.
2. زمان‌بندی دقیق فازبندی (طراحی UI فیگما -> پیاده‌سازی -> تست و تحویل).
3. استک فنی پیشنهادی شما (نحوه پیاده‌سازی قالب و تم).

We regret to inform you that currently, Amsive DOES NOT provide sponsorship opportunities.

This is a REMOTE or HYBRID position. If Hybrid it's 1-2 days in office, located in New York, NY or Nashville, TN.

What we are looking for :

Amsive is looking for a Sr. Specialist, SEO who will support Amsive organic search clients, particularly including but not limited to those in the health, financial, technology and B2B space. We’re looking for a curious problem solver to support our team in helping develop and execute search-driven content and technical strategies for our clients. This candidate will be responsible for handling a range of activities independently and in collaboration with a larger organic search team.

You should have a passion for the digital world, a propensity to problem-solve, phenomenal attention to detail, and a boundless desire to learn. Our most successful team members are often both "right-brained" (creative) and "left-brained" (analytical). They are also strong team players, as collaboration and education are very important within our organic search department.

What you will be doing:

Help define and execute organic search strategy for Amsive's clients, with a focus on content strategy and optimization
Understanding of current SEO and AEO best practices, search engine ranking factors, digital content marketing, technical SEO, intermediate marketing principles, and a strong grasp on how to help clients meet business goals.
Conduct comprehensive site audits, identify content and technical SEO opportunities, and prioritize recommendations based on business impact and implementation effort.
Document recommended solutions, working with internal and client marketing and development teams to advise on implementation
Perform competitive analyses to identify organic search opportunities.
Monitor and analyze client sites’ performance using a range of SEO, AI, and site analytics tools.

Skilled in managing time effectively to handle various tasks while delivering high-quality results on time.

Experience with Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Google Data Studio, and APIs for data analysis and reporting. In addition strong proficiency in Google docs and Excel

items.description:
🔴 طراحی فروشگاه آنلاین کمپرسور و روغن صنعتی با تعریف 60 محصول

🔹 من به دنبال یک طراح سایت حرفه‌ای وردپرس هستم که بتواند یک سایت فروشگاهی با محوریت فروش کنترل‌کننده‌های صنعتی طراحی کند. جزئیات پروژه به شرح زیر است:
اگر بخواهم سادگی (یا سختی) سایت مدنظرم را نشان بدهم، سایت www.saga-co.ir نمونه مناسبی است. با این تفاوت که در سایت ایران ساگا ریموت کنترل تایوانی و چینی یک برند فروخته می شود. اما در سایت مد نظر من کمپرسور و روغن یک برند فروخته می شود (که طبیعتا تفاوتی با هم ندارند).
مشخصات پروژه:
طراحی سایت فروشگاهی با استفاده از وردپرس و صفحه‌ساز المنتور
استفاده از ووکامرس برای بخش فروشگاهی
سئو مناسب و اصولی برای تمامی صفحات، مخصوصاً صفحات محصول
بارگذاری و بهینه‌سازی (سئو) محتوا شامل: متن، عکس و ویدئوی مربوط به 60 محصول (توسط کارفرما ارائه می‌شود)
طراحی ریسپانسیو و سریع، با رعایت تجربه کاربری مناسب
دریافت و قرار دادن نماد اعتماد الکترونیکی (ای‌نماد) در سایت توسط طراح
مهلت نهایی تحویل پروژه: حداکثر ۲۰ روز کاری

items.description:
Summary

Are you passionate about SEO and driving business growth through organic search? We're looking for a Senior SEO Specialist to help shape and execute our global SEO strategy, improve website visibility, and support growth across international markets. You'll work closely with content, development, UX, and marketing teams to deliver impactful SEO initiatives.

Job Description

What will you do?

Conduct keyword research, keyword mapping, and identify search opportunities across multiple markets.
Manage on-page, off-page, and technical SEO activities.
Implement SEO recommendations in CMS platforms, including metadata, redirects, hreflang tags, and internal linking.
Perform SEO audits and identify optimization opportunities.
Analyze competitors and industry trends.
Collaborate with content, UX, CRO, and development teams to implement SEO improvements.
Monitor SEO performance, including traffic, rankings, and technical health.
Support content creation through keyword insights and optimization recommendations.
Help develop and maintain SEO standards and best practices.
Stay up to date with search engine updates and SEO trends.

What are we looking for?

At least 3 years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally in an international environment.
English at C1 level or higher.
Proven track record of growing organic traffic, rankings, and conversions.

Strong knowledge of:

Technical SEO (crawlability, indexing, site structure, redirects, structured data)
On-page and off-page SEO
Keyword research and content optimization
Competitor analysis and market research
Link building and backlink analysis
SEO auditing and performance monitoring
SEO-driven content strategy
HTML and CSS fundamentals

Experience with:

Ahrefs
Semrush
Google Search Console
Google Analytics (GA4)
SEO auditing tools such as Screaming Frog

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail.
Proactive and self-driven approach.
Good organizational and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results.

Why you'll thrive in this role

You'll enjoy this role if you like combining technical SEO, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, continuously improve performance, and make a measurable impact on organic growth.

Ready to help millions of users discover our products and content through search? We'd love to hear from you.

items.title: Senior SEO Specialist
items.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a technically strong Senior SEO Specialist who can independently own SEO projects, from strategy and execution to performance and results.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, analytical, and capable of identifying problems, making informed decisions, and driving projects forward without constant supervision.

Key Responsibilities
Independently manage SEO projects with complete ownership of strategy, execution, timelines, and performance.
Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, identify critical issues, and work with developers to implement solutions.
Develop and execute SEO strategies covering technical SEO, content, on-page optimization, internal linking, and organic growth.
Stay updated with AEO, GEO, Google AI Overviews, LLM-driven search, and emerging trends in organic discovery.
Analyze performance using GA4, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools to identify opportunities and improve results.
Communicate directly with clients, present recommendations, manage expectations, and ensure timely delivery.

Required Skills & Experience
4 to 5 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably managing multiple accounts in a digital marketing agency.
Strong technical SEO expertise in crawling, indexing, JavaScript SEO, canonicalization, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and site architecture.
Solid understanding of keyword research, search intent, content strategy, topical authority, and on-page SEO.
Working knowledge of AEO, GEO, AI-powered search platforms, and their implications for organic visibility.
Proficiency with Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, and GA4.
Ability to independently troubleshoot complex SEO issues, prioritize initiatives, and deliver measurable outcomes.
Strong communication, client management, and project ownership skills.

Why Bluvo?
Above-market compensation. We would rather invest in one genuinely strong professional than build a larger team that requires constant supervision.
Depth over volume. We intentionally work with a limited number of clients so we can focus on delivering meaningful results.
Meaningful technical work. You'll have the opportunity to investigate complex challenges, develop strategies, and solve problems instead of simply working through tickets.

What Matters Most
We value people who take ownership, think independently, communicate clearly, and follow through on their commitments.

We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks. We want someone who can confidently lead SEO projects, take initiative, and continuously raise the quality of work.

How to Apply
Share your updated resume along with 1 or 2 SEO projects you've independently managed, highlighting the challenges, your contributions, and measurable results.

🔹 به دنبال متخصص باتجربه‌ای برای بررسی و بهینه‌سازی سرعت سایت فعال WordPress و WooCommerce هستیم. هدف، شناسایی ریشه‌ای مشکلات احتمالی و بهبود واقعی عملکرد صفحات در موبایل و دسکتاپ است؛ کار نباید صرفاً به افزایش امتیاز PageSpeed یا تنظیم افزونه‌های کش محدود شود.
صفحات مورد بررسی شامل صفحه اصلی و فروشگاه، صفحات دسته‌بندی و محصولات، مقالات و صفحات فرود مهم است. بهینه‌سازی باید اصولی و در سطح انواع صفحات موردنظر انجام شود، نه فقط یک صفحه مشخص.
دامنه فنی کار شامل بررسی و بهینه‌سازی CSS، JavaScript، تصاویر، فونت‌ها و منابع مسدودکننده رندر، و نیز بررسی Cache، TTFB، دیتابیس، قالب و افزونه‌هاست. همچنین شاخص‌های Core Web Vitals شامل LCP، INP و CLS باید ارزیابی و مشکلات احتمالی آن‌ها برطرف شود.

items.description:
🔴 طراحی وب‌سایتی شبیه استور‌یاب یا ترب

🔹 **عنوان پروژه: طراحی و توسعه وب‌سایت مقایسه و جست‌وجوی محصولات مشابه ترب و استوریاب**
به دنبال یک فریلنسر یا تیم حرفه‌ای برای طراحی و پیاده‌سازی وب‌سایتی با ایده‌ای مشابه پلتفرم‌های جست‌وجو، معرفی و مقایسه محصولات مانند «ترب» و «استوریاب» هستیم. هدف، ایجاد یک وب‌سایت مدرن، زیبا، کاربرپسند و قابل توسعه است که تجربه مناسبی برای کاربران در جست‌وجو و بررسی محصولات یا فروشگاه‌ها فراهم کند.
### شرح کلی پروژه
- طراحی رابط کاربری حرفه‌ای و واکنش‌گرا برای موبایل، تبلت و دسکتاپ
- پیاده‌سازی ساختار و منطق کلی وب‌سایت با الهام از نمونه‌های مشابه
- توجه ویژه به سرعت، سادگی مسیر کاربر و ظاهر مدرن سایت
- امکان توسعه قابلیت‌ها و بخش‌های جدید در آینده
- طراحی پنل مدیریتی مناسب برای مدیریت محتوا، محصولات، دسته‌بندی‌ها و سایر اطلاعات موردنیاز
### قابلیت‌ها و بخش‌های احتمالی
جزئیات نهایی امکانات، میزان شباهت به نمونه‌ها و اولویت‌بندی بخش‌ها در مراحل بعدی مشخص خواهد شد؛ اما پروژه می‌تواند شامل موارد زیر باشد:
- صفحه اصلی و صفحات دسته‌بندی
- جست‌وجوی پیشرفته و فیلتر نتایج
- صفحات معرفی یا جزئیات محصول
- مقایسه قیمت، فروشگاه‌ها یا ویژگی‌های محصولات
- سیستم مدیریت اطلاعات از طریق پنل ادمین
- ثبت، ویرایش و دسته‌بندی محصولات و فروشگاه‌ها
- طراحی بهینه برای موتورهای جست‌وجو (SEO)
- امکان اتصال به API یا منابع داده در صورت نیاز
### مهارت‌ها و انتظارات
- تسلط به طراحی و توسعه وب‌سایت‌های حرفه‌ای
- تجربه در طراحی سایت‌های فروشگاهی، مارکت‌پلیس، موتور جست‌وجو یا مقایسه قیمت مزیت محسوب می‌شود
- توانایی پیشنهاد راهکار فنی مناسب بر اساس نیاز پروژه
- رعایت اصول UI/UX، امنیت، بهینه‌سازی و قابلیت توسعه‌پذیری
- ارائه نمونه‌کارهای مرتبط در پیشنهاد همکاری
لطفاً در پیشنهاد خود، تکنولوژی پیشنهادی، زمان‌بندی تقریبی اجرا، هزینه و نمونه‌کارهای مشابه را اعلام کنید.

items.description:
Sobre Persuadis
En Persuadis somos una agencia de marketing digital especializada en el sector inmobiliario. Trabajamos con promotoras de toda España y hacemos webs, landing pages, campañas de captación de leads, analítica y automatización. Buscamos a alguien que domine el posicionamiento clásico y que entienda cómo está cambiando la búsqueda con la inteligencia artificial.
Qué harás
SEO: auditorías técnicas y on-page, keyword research, arquitectura web, enlazado interno, optimización de contenidos y seguimiento de posiciones para webs corporativas y microsites de promociones.
SEM: crear, gestionar y optimizar campañas de Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display y YouTube) orientadas a la captación de leads cualificados, con control de presupuesto, CPL y conversiones.
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): trabajar para que nuestros clientes aparezcan y sean citados en respuestas de IA como ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini o Claude. Eso incluye datos estructurados, contenido citable, señales de autoridad y menciones de marca.
Analítica: medir resultados con GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console y Looker Studio, y preparar informes claros para el cliente.
Usar herramientas de IA en el día a día para análisis, clustering de keywords, generación y optimización de contenidos, creatividades y automatización de tareas.
Colaborar con los equipos de cuentas, contenidos, diseño y desarrollo web.
Qué buscamos
Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en SEO y/o SEM, en agencia o en cliente.
Dominio de Google Ads, Search Console, GA4 y herramientas como Semrush, Ahrefs o Screaming Frog.
Conocimientos de SEO técnico: indexación, Core Web Vitals, schema.org y WordPress u otros CMS.
Interés real y actualizado por la IA y la búsqueda generativa. Que sigas las novedades, pruebes herramientas nuevas y sepas explicar qué funciona y qué no.
Mentalidad orientada a resultados: tráfico, leads y retorno de la inversión.
Se valorará:
Experiencia en el sector inmobiliario.
Certificaciones de Google Ads.
Experiencia con Meta Ads.
Nociones de automatización con herramientas como Zapier o Make.
Inglés y/o catalán.

Qué ofrecemos
Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.
Salario de 22.000 € a 28.000 € brutos al año, según experiencia.
Horario:
De lunes a jueves, de 8:45 a 14:00 y de 15:00 a 18:00.
Viernes, jornada intensiva de 8:15 a 15:00.
Oficina en Rambla Catalunya 123, Barcelona.
Proyectos para promotoras de primer nivel, con presupuestos de campaña relevantes.
Margen para probar y aplicar nuevas estrategias de IA y GEO, en un área en plena evolución.
Formación continua y un equipo con el que crecer.

The candidate is required to possess outstanding command on the English language (vocabulary, reading, writing & speaking) – since s/he will need to initiate communications with our link partners in the UK & USA. This individual will also be responsible for supporting analytics and reporting efforts on a regular basis. This candidate will work independently for the most part; but s/he would be occasionally required to work closely with other teams to identify and improve the technical factors of our site(s) or support cross-functional marketing campaigns.

Analyze select web portals using 3rd party plugins and competitive intelligence tools to identify technical SEO factors or potential link building opportunities.

Identify ways to enable outreach and initiate communication with prospective site owners for link building opportunities – using email, phone calls, social media & other avenues.

Work independently on all aspects of SEO, including keyword research, content strategy, outreach and link building – to enhance organic search visibility for our web properties, blogs and mobile sites.

Manage on-page and off-page SEO efforts by optimizing content, overseeing reporting, conducting regular SEO audits for core keyword groups, and pro-actively seeking out and negotiating relevant link placements on external websites to increase organic rankings.

Work with the SEO team in developing SEO best practices and strategy for web search, social media, viral marketing, images and video for our various sites and blogs.

Work on off-page SEO to attract external links and citations through a variety of marketing efforts.

Monitor Google Webmaster Tools to identify site issues, such as crawl errors and html suggestions communicate with technical teams to resolve issues.

Monitor, track and report on SEO performance and trends.

Research and stay up-to-date on new developments, trends and technologies within the SEO space.

Minimum of two (2) years experience with advanced level off-page & on-page SEO.

Outstanding communication skills (verbal & written) with a reasonable English vocabulary usage.

Prior experience using SEO analysis/research tools like AHREFS, Magestic, SEOmoz, or similar tools.

Proven ability to manage on-page optimizations (metadata/site structure, keyword usage, internal linking, unique content, etc.)

Web analytics experience with knowledge of analytical tools such as Google Analytics & Google Webmaster Tools.

Self-motivated, detail oriented, ability to prioritize, multi-task and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Preferred Skills

Prior experience getting page 1 rankings on Google, Yahoo and Bing.

Prior experience in managing link cleansing (bad links removal) campaigns.
